When Guest House won the Golden Slipper and later became a multi-million dollar stallion prospect, it vindicated everything Newington Farm believes about educating young Thoroughbreds. Kacy Blaxland explains to TTR why great horses are rarely accidents, and why attention to the smallest details can shape a career.

Sminky Shorts topped a successful Magic Millions Digital Sale at $365,000, headlining the Forest View Farm Unreserved Dispersal. The proven producer, offered in foal to Anamoe, led strong demand as part of the dispersal, while there was good competition for some other desired lots.

Giving a horse a name is an important part of the ownership journey. Naming a horse now, with over a month before the first 2-year-old trials, shows a level of excitement about their potential precocity. TTR checked in on the First Season Sires to see which stallion’s progeny are already thrilling their owners enough to give them a name.

From G1 Golden Slipper winners to an Everest hero, Matt Vella has helped educate some of Australia's best thoroughbreds. Operating from Hawkesbury, the respected horseman explains the philosophy behind his breaking and pre-training operation, the importance of patience and why every horse tells a different story.

On the opening day of the racing season, syndicator Matthew Corban and trainer Will Freedman hit the ground running with Attractiveness, who scored her first Saturday metropolitan win. The victory opens more doors for more collaboration in the future as both seek to deliver a truly enjoyable ownership experience.

The Ciaron Maher-trained Gringotts stamped himself as a horse ready to make an immediate impact this spring with an impressive Warwick Farm trial. While Warnie and Tornado Valley both impressed in the other two Group trials, and two exciting 3-year-olds also produced eye-catching winning performances.

Churchill Downs and the NYRA have launched a new six-race series for 3-year-olds, where participating horses can earn a share of a US$5 million prize pool on top of the riches already available in the G1 Kentucky Derby, the G1 Belmont Stakes, and the G1 Travers Stakes.
